choices.content: Every category must be carried out once
Several categories of ways are mutually exclusive, and completing the task requires choosing a way from just one category
Each step must be followed by the next step
A way may belong to two categories simultaneously, and the counts are still added

question.prompt: In which situation does the addition principle of counting apply?

solutions.explanation: The categories must be mutually exclusive, and completing a way from any one category completes the task. When the categories overlap, their counts cannot be added directly.
solutions.title: Recognize the addition principle
